name: Crazy Egg
description: Crazy Egg is a website-optimization platform that shows how visitors actually use a site, combining heatmaps, session recordings, A/B testing, and web analytics in one dashboard.
best_for: Teams of any skill level, including those with multiple websites or team members, seeking to understand visitor behavior without complex configuration, with unlimited seats and domains on its plans.
features: Heatmaps, Scrollmaps, and Confetti Maps visualizing visitor interaction
Session recordings to watch actual user behavior
A/B testing to run conversion experiments
Web analytics with real-time, AI-powered traffic reporting
Popup CTAs including buttons, popups, and sticky bars
Error tracking for technical issues affecting user experience
Single-snippet setup with integrations for Google Tag Manager, Shopify, and WordPress

alternatives.name: Hotjar
alternatives.description: An experience-intelligence platform for understanding and improving user behavior on websites/apps.
alternatives.best_for: Product, design, and marketing teams wanting to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion.

alternatives.name: FullStory
alternatives.description: An AI-powered behavioral analytics platform capturing user interactions across web and mobile.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing deeper session replay and product analytics alongside heatmaps.

pricing.starting_price: Free plan available; paid heatmap/recording plans start at $29/month, billed annually

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Includes Web Analytics, Instant Heatmaps, Conversion Analytics, and website Surveys.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Monthly equivalent; billed annually. Includes 5,000 tracked pageviews/month, 5 heatmap reports, and 50 recordings/month.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Monthly equivalent; billed annually. Adds A/B testing, CTAs, error tracking, and higher limits.

cons: Starter does not include A/B Testing, Popup CTAs, or Error Tracking; those capabilities begin on the $99/month Plus tier.
Crazy Egg does not charge overages, but tracking pauses when monthly plan limits are reached until the next month unless you upgrade or add capacity.
